svg.text: 2. NOT A CRASH HELMET. Printed VR enclosure: never ride, drive, cycle or walk around in it.
3. Shell: 6 sections, 2.4 mm walls (LW-PLA or PETG), joined with M3 inserts.
4. Field of view ~106 x 74 deg, ray-traced model (upper bound).
5. Source of truth: cad/products/vr.py (regenerate with python -m cad.generate).
mm | 253 W x 389 D x 314 H
